variables.issue_title: POST /api/v1/checkout intermittently returns HTTP 500 in payments-api
variables.issue_body:
Service: Go payments-api (`POST /api/v1/checkout`, v2.14.0 on Linux amd64). Client: iOS 18.1 Safari.
Error log: `panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference at payments/checkout.go:142 (applyPromoCode)`.
We haven't been able to reproduce this locally yet — we don't know what cart state, promo code combination, or request sequence triggers the 500.

variables.issue_title: Document missing repro steps template warning in ISSUE_TEMPLATE
variables.issue_body: Update `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml` to add a required textarea field labeled `Reproduction Steps` with placeholder text `Describe the exact steps to reproduce, including error logs and environment`. Acceptance criteria: YAML parses cleanly and includes `validations: { required: true }`.

We should add per-caller rate limiting to `POST /api/decide` in `cmd/serve.go` returning HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header when exceeded. Exact burst/sustained defaults and whether `/health` is exempt are not finalized yet.
